dedupe_keys.name: openrailwaymap railway infrastructure map built on openstreetmap

description: OpenRailwayMap is a detailed online map of the world's railway infrastructure built on OpenStreetMap data, online since mid-2013, with a vector-tile reimplementation (OpenRailwayMap-vector) at openrailwaymap.app since 2024. It shows railways, subways, trams, miniature railways and funiculars with details such as track types, station names, track numbers, milestones and permitted speeds; aerialways, monorails and maglevs are excluded. Beyond the map, the project develops a consistent data model for railway tagging in OpenStreetMap, editor plugins and discussion channels, so that railway data can be collected and reused by other applications. Coverage of the raster map is worldwide and the vector version lists Europe and North America. The map is free, its software is under GNU GPL 3.0, and the underlying data are OpenStreetMap data that can be extracted from OpenStreetMap under the ODbL; overlays can be used in apps such as OsmAnd. Caveats: completeness depends on volunteer mapping and varies strongly between countries, and the map itself is a viewer, not a download service. It supports building rail network models with track and speed attributes, hazard exposure of lines and stations, and checks of official rail inventories. It complements the national rail network datasets catalogued here.
